description: Screenshot of a Q post (No.207, tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCl, dated 09/10/18) rendered in all-caps green-on-lavender board formatting. The drop claims that declassification of FISA material would force Rod Rosenstein's resignation/recusal/removal, that all FISA signers are under investigation, and that the Obama ('Hussein') administration knowingly presented false evidence to the FISC to surveil candidate Trump, with alleged UK/AUS spy insertion coordinated under Brennan and Clapper. These are the drop's claims, not established facts.

DECLAS OF FISA WILL INITIATE THE 'AWARENESS' THAT ALL SIGNERS WILL BE [CURRENTLY] UNDER INVESTIGATION. DECLAS OF FISA WILL FACTUALLY DEMONSTRATE WITHOUT ARGUMENT THE US GOVERNMENT, UNDER HUSSEIN, KNOWINGLY, PRESENTED FALSE EVIDENCE TO FISC IN AN EFFORT TO OBTAIN 'LEGAL' US INTELLIGENCE 'UMBRELLA' SURV OF POTUS [IDEN TARGET] FOR THE SOLE PURPOSE OF INFLUENCING THE 2016 ELECTION OF THE PRESIDENCY [NOT RUSSIA BUT HUSSEIN/HRC - PROJECTION] + SAFEGUARD AGAINST POSSIBLE LOSS OF POWER [FIREWALLS]. USE OF BACKCHANNEL SURV / SPY INSERTION [BODY 1, 2, AND 5] BY UK/AUS [PRIMARY] ACTIVATED UNDER DIR BRENNAN DIR CLAPPER W/ PDB REGULAR UPDATES + [LIVE STREAMING] WH HUSSEIN NON-OVAL [SITUATION ROOM] COORDINATION. FISA [FULL] BRINGS DOWN THE HOUSE [WH]. Q

'Hussein' and 'HRC' are the drop's shorthand for Barack Obama and Hillary Clinton

description: Screenshot of Q drop 1667 (No.2007911, tripcode !CbboFOtcZs, ID e429ce, Jul 3 2018), which quotes an earlier Q post No.2007869 from the same date. The quoted post links a Breitbart article about Devin Nunes referring ten Obama officials to a House joint task force and tells readers to re-read drops about Five Eyes/FVEY, claiming '[UK] - primary' and 'We have the server.' The reply then quotes a passage stating Nunes said the intelligence launching the FBI investigation was not shared through official Five Eyes channels. These are the drops' and the article's claims.
text: Q !CbboFOtcZs ID: e429ce No.2007911 1667. Jul 3 2018 00:54:59 (EST). Q !CbboFOtcZs ID: e429ce No.2007869. Jul 3 2018 00:52:44 (EST). https://www.breitbart.com/big-government/2018/07/02/nunes-refers-ten-obama-officials-to-house-judiciary-and-oversight-joint-task-force/amp/?__twitter_impression=true. Re_ read drops re: Five Eyes / FVEY. Will be extremely important going forward. [UK] - primary. Turn taken. FBI/DOJ to State / Hussein WH (inc C_A / other appointment Start) to Foreign Bad Actors. [RR] deadline? We have the server. Q. >>2007869. “Normally, intelligence passed on from a member of the “Five Eyes” alliance — Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the U.K., and the U.S. — to another member comes through an official channel for intelligence sharing. However, Nunes, upon reviewing the document that formally launched the FBI’s investigation, said there was no intelligence shared through that official channel, meaning that the intelligence was shared through unofficial means.” Q
flags: 'Hussein' and '[RR]' are the drop's shorthand for Barack Obama and Rod Rosenstein
Claims about unofficial intelligence sharing and 'the server' are the drop's/article's assertions, unverified
